## About
Cleveland Air Conditioning Inc. works on air conditioning and heating out of Kennedale, on Pennsylvania Ave. We handle sales, repair, maintenance and installation, for your home and family or for your office.
We like to say we're large enough that you can count on us being here when you need us, but still small enough to care about your comfort. We're an American Standard authorized dealer and a Lennox authorized dealer, and our technicians are EPA and NATE certified.
Chris Cleveland is the name you'll hear in our reviews. A reviewer from Arlington calls Cleveland AC a local Mom and Pop place, not a huge chain.

## Services
- Air conditioning and heating repair: Repair and upkeep for your cooling and heating equipment, from a simple fix to a tricky diagnosis.
- Gas and electric furnaces: We work on both gas and electric furnaces.
- New air conditioners and heat pumps: Quality products at competitive prices when it's time for a new air conditioner or heat pump.
- Maintenance program: Regular check-ups catch small problems before they turn into bigger, more expensive ones.
- 24 hour service: We're available around the clock when your equipment needs attention.

## FAQ
Q: How often should I have my system checked?
A: We recommend an air conditioning check-up every spring and a furnace check-up every fall.

Q: Do you work on my brand of equipment?
A: Yes. We offer service, repair and maintenance on any and all makes and models.

Q: How do I set up an appointment?
A: Give us a call at 817-714-1874 with any questions or to book a visit.
